verdict.rationale: Linear documents importing data from other services, a Jira migration path, GitHub issue sync and a 'My Issues → Assigned' section. None of this is a unified view that pulls a user's assigned tasks from multiple external project management tools. Import and migration move data into Linear rather than aggregating live tasks across tools, so they are adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view
